compile_model_with_torch: apply torch.compile to a model using CompileOptions for fullgraph, dynamic, mode, and backend settings
review_compile_model_function: review the _compile_model function that applies torch.compile to a _ModelHolder with given CompileOptions
handle_torch_compile_errors: handle TorchCompileError and TorchCompileNotSupportedError exceptions raised during model compilation
configure_compile_options: configure CompileOptions with fullgraph, dynamic, mode, backend, and backend_options for torch.compile
check_model_compilation_support: check if a model family supports compilation via the supports_compilation attribute before compiling
